description: Master Claude API integration for Catchbook's core AI features: species identification from photos and intelligent prompt engineering. Build production-ready AI pipelines with confidence scoring, fallback logic, and automated validation using Claude Code workflows.
catchbook_focus: Implement Catchbook's species identification system using Claude's vision capabilities. Apply structured outputs, confidence scoring, and prompt optimization techniques. Automate AI validation workflows with Claude Code to ensure high accuracy and reliability in production.
entry_criteria: Completed Phase 14 (Advanced SQL and data visualization)
FastAPI backend operational with image upload endpoints
Basic understanding of machine learning concepts
Claude API key obtained and configured
Familiarity with Claude Code CLI from Phase 2
exit_criteria: Species identification endpoint deployed with >80% accuracy on test set
Confidence scoring system with manual override for low-confidence predictions
Prompt templates optimized for species ID accuracy (v2.0)
Fallback logic implemented for edge cases and rare species
Automated validation pipeline using Claude Code hooks
Custom Claude Code commands for species ID development patterns
Cost monitoring and optimization strategies documented
Comprehensive test suite for AI endpoints with >90% coverage

modules.catchbook_deliverable: Automated species ID validation using Claude Code hooks
